assessment: This study presents solid data on the computational identification of 25 putative human genomic safe harbor loci, of which 3 have been experimentally validated using human embryonic stem cells, that may serve as safe sites for transgene integration. These findings will be an invaluable resource in cell and gene therapy applications. This work will be of interest to cell biologists and researchers in the stem cell field.
